stop_conditions: If watch counts or breadth grow, the cn_watch_seen read (~300x the candidate scan) is the dominant D1 quota term and must be optimised BEFORE adding facets.
Do NOT reintroduce a LIMIT on the seen read to bound it: that trades correctness for boundedness and re-notifies future-dated policy items (this round's fix 3 defeating fix 2).

unresolved_risks: The cn_watch_seen read is unbounded by design (bounded instead by window pruning): ~46k rows per typical view, ~301k worst case, against D1's 5M rows/day free tier -- fine for a single user, honestly recorded as a real tail risk rather than smoothed over.
This is a subset of T066, not T066: no topic/agency/region/entity facets (needs S5), no content_hash substantive-change detection (needs T026), no silence signal.

A benign re-notification path remains: a feed item absent 30+ days that reappears has its fetched_at bumped (worker_cloud.js:239), so for NULL-published_at items it re-enters the window and notifies again -- acceptable, since it genuinely is new to the watch.
